name: mcp-coder
description: Local coding executor for Claude Desktop.
long_description: mcp-coder delegates narrow, verified coding tasks to a configured Anthropic Messages-compatible model. Claude remains responsible for planning and review.

llm_token.title: LLM token
llm_token.description: Token for the configured Anthropic Messages-compatible API.

base_url.title: LLM base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of the compatible API, without a trailing slash.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model identifier passed to the API.

max_agent_steps.title: Maximum agent steps
max_agent_steps.description: Maximum tool-use iterations per coding task.

max_total_context_chars.title: Maximum context characters
max_total_context_chars.description: Combined context budget for a coding task.

max_output_tokens.title: Maximum output tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Output-token budget for each model call.

request_timeout_ms.title: API timeout (ms)
request_timeout_ms.description: Timeout for a model API request.

command_timeout_ms.title: Command timeout (ms)
command_timeout_ms.description: Timeout for an allowed verification command.
